   The odds of a September interest rate hike have risen to 85% from 72% a day earlier and roughly 50% a month ago.
   Friday’s change in expectations came after new inflation data showed that price pressures remain well above the Fed’s target.
   Fed officials have remained divided on policy this summer, with some favoring holding rates steady and others pushing for hikes to bring inflation down to target.
